children: KKR & Co. Inc., through affiliate Tarheel Investors III L.P., acquired a 14.0% stake in Integer Holdings Corporation. The stake became reportable after equity swaps settled on Oct. 5, 2026, and the group filed a Schedule 13D on Oct. 13, 2026. The position comes alongside a signed agreement for KKR affiliates to acquire Integer for cash.

KKR affiliates agreed to buy Integer under a definitive merger signed on Aug. 2, 2026. At closing, "each share of Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time... will... receive $127 in cash," subject to customary conditions.

Tarheel Investors III L.P. settled physically settled swaps to obtain 4,753,677 shares and also holds a cash-settled swap tied to 836,392 shares with no voting rights. To fund the deal, a KKR affiliate "has committed to invest... to enable Parent to pay the Merger Consideration," and provided a limited guarantee covering certain Parent obligations.

KKR & Co. Inc. is a Delaware corporation and a global investment firm that manages private equity, credit, and real assets strategies. The firm is known for large-scale buyouts and long-term investments across sectors, including healthcare and medical technology. KKR often uses dedicated acquisition vehicles and equity commitments to fund take-private transactions.
